_comment: Cross-check fixture for plan 261016 Phase 7 (SC-5). PowerAtlas tests/test_web.py materializes it in a temp folder (a committed fixture cannot hold .git directories) and asserts that the store resolver and PowerAtlas overview._get_store_dir both return each folder's expected store. {ws} in a path stands for the temp workspace root; a folder with git set is a repository whose origin is remote. expect is store:<dir> (a directory of the scratch store repo, serving plans) or none. Each store holds plans/<plan>.md, because the resolver counts only a store that holds content.
